proof:
letI : IsScalarTower (R p) ℚ ℂ :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun r => rfl)
  let μ : (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ :=
    (J p M (ev y v 0)).subtype.liftBaseChange ℚ
  have hden : ∀ t : ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0),
      ∃ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ c : J p M (ev y v 0),
        (n : ℚ) • t = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] c := by
    
    intro t
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, 0, by simp⟩
    | tmul q c =>
      refine ⟨q.den, q.den_ne_zero, (q.num : R p) • c, ?_⟩
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, Rat.den_mul_eq_num]
      rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
      simp [Algebra.smul_def]
    | add a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn, c, hc⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨m, hm, d, hd⟩ := hb
      refine ⟨n * m, Nat.mul_ne_zero hn hm, m • c + n • d, ?_⟩
      rw [smul_add, Nat.cast_mul]
      calc
        ((n : ℚ) * m) • a + ((n : ℚ) * m) • b =
            (m : ℚ) • ((n : ℚ) • a) + (n : ℚ) • ((m : ℚ) • b) := by
              simp only [smul_smul]; rw [mul_comm (m : ℚ) n]
        _ = (m : ℚ) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] c) +
            (n : ℚ) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] d) := by rw [hc, hd]
        _ = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] (m • c + n • d) := by
          simp [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← TensorProduct.tmul_smul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
    
  constructor
  · refine ⟨μ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q c
      change q • (c : ℂ) = _
      simp [Algebra.smul_def]
    · apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero μ).2
      intro t ht
      obtain ⟨n, hn, c, hc⟩ := hden t
      have hc0 : c = 0 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        have hh := congrArg μ hc
        simpa only [map_smul, ht, smul_zero, μ,
          LinearMap.liftBaseChange_one_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply,
          Submodule.coe_zero] using hh.symm
      have hnt : (n : ℚ) • t = 0 := by
        rw [hc, hc0, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hnt).resolve_left (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn)
    · simp [μ, LinearMap.range_liftBaseChange]
  · letI : Module.Finite (R p) (J p M (ev y v 0)) :=
      Module.Finite.of_fg h_T011.2.2.1
    infer_instance
statement:
(∃ μ : (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ,
  (∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J p M (ev y v 0)), μ (q ⊗ₜ[R p] c) = (q : ℂ) * (c : ℂ)) ∧
  Function.Injective μ ∧ LinearMap.range μ = Submodule.span ℚ (J p M (ev y v 0) : Set ℂ)) ∧ (Module.Finite ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)))

T012 : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type) [instK : Field K] (l : ℤ) (V : Type) [instV : AddCommGroup V] [instCV : Module ℂ V]
  (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p →
    ((∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ scalarRing p ↔ ∃ a b, ¬↑p ∣ b ∧ q = ↑a / ↑b) ∧
        ((∃ ι, iotaSpec p M ι ∧ Function.Injective ⇑ι ∧ ι.range = L p M) ∧
            Nonempty (Module.Basis (Ix l) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
              Submodule.span ℂ ↑M = ⊤ ∧
                (∀ (r : ℕ), Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r)) ∧
                  Preserves M x ∧
                    Preserves M y ∧
                      Preserves M h ∧
                        (∀ (r : ℕ), (∀ u ∈ L p M, (divided x r) u ∈ L p M) ∧ ∀ u ∈ L p M, (divided y r) u ∈ L p M) ∧
                          (∀ u ∈ L p M, x u ∈ L p M ∧ y u ∈ L p M ∧ h u ∈ L p M) ∧
                            (∃ fx fy fh, LiftOf M x fx ∧ LiftOf M y fy ∧ LiftOf M h fh) ∧
                              ∃ DX DY, ∀ (r : ℕ), LiftOf M (divided x r) (DX r) ∧ LiftOf M (divided y r) (DY r)) ∧
          (∀ (B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V),
              (∀ (i : Ix l), B i = ev y v ↑i) →
                divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat = matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
                  (∀ (i : Ix l),
                      divided x (l.toNat - ↑i) * (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) =
                        matrixUnit B i (Fin.last l.toNat)) ∧
                    (∀ (j : Ix l),
                        divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat * divided y (l.toNat - ↑j) =
                          ↑(l.toNat.choose ↑j) • matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) j) ∧
                      ∀ (j : Ix l), IsUnit ↑(l.toNat.choose ↑j)) ∧
            ∀ (B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V),
              (∀ (i : Ix l), B i = ev y v ↑i) →
                ∀ (i j : Ix l),
                  matrixUnit B i j =
                      (↑(l.toNat.choose ↑j))⁻¹ •
                        (divided x (l.toNat - ↑i) * (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) *
                          divided y (l.toNat - ↑j)) ∧
                    ∀ u ∈ L p M, (matrixUnit B i j) u ∈ L p M) →
      (∀ (i : Ix l), J p M (ev y v ↑i) = J p M (ev y v 0)) ∧
          (∃ s, ∀ (c : Ix l → ↥(J p M (ev y v 0))), ↑(s c) = ∑ i, ↑(c i) • ev y v ↑i) ∧
            (J p M (ev y v 0)).FG ∧ J p M (ev y v 0) ≠ ⊥ →
        (∃ μ,
            (∀ (q : ℚ) (c : ↥(J p M (ev y v 0))), μ (q ⊗ₜ[R p] c) = ↑q * ↑c) ∧
              Function.Injective ⇑μ ∧ μ.range = Submodule.span ℚ ↑(J p M (ev y v 0))) ∧
          Module.Finite ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] ↥(J p M (ev y v 0)))
